dataset.description: To collect survey data on office workers' opinions and attitudes regarding fatigue as a multidimensional construct and its impact on performance in relation to psychosocial risks at work. The survey will include demographic questions, open-ended questions, and Likert-scale items. Data collected through the survey will be combined with physical measurements to provide a comprehensive assessment of fatigue as a multidimensional construct and its impact on work performance in relation to psychosocial risks at work.

distribution.title: To Measure fatigue as a multidimensional variable

dataset.title: Assessment of fatigue as a multidimensional construct and its impact on work performance in relation to psychosocial risks at work (survey combined with physical measurements).

dmp.description: The aim of this project is to investigate the impact of fatigue as a multidimensional variable on the performance of office workers in relation to psycho-emotional risks at work and develop scientifically valid and causal evidence-based recommendations to reduce physical and mental fatigue and improve performance as well as develop a set of digital tests that can be used in an office context to assess physical, cognitive and emotional fatigue.
dmp.ethical_issues_description: The study involves the collection of sensitive medical and physiological data, which requires careful consideration of ethical and legal requirements. The study will be conducted with prior approval from the relevant Research Ethics Committee.
